_comment: Full overnight training pipeline config (run_training.py). A run is fully described by repo state: commit this file with any change. JSON not YAML: zero extra dependencies.

lstm._signal: achieved = train on per-frame achieved-throughput series generated by gen_lstm_dataset.py under the current transport model (matches what the predictor is FED at inference); capacity = legacy DL_bitrate training
lstm._select_metric: transform winner picked by the low-bandwidth-regime MAE (where ABR tier choices flip); ties broken by overall mae

dqn_sweep._axes: 3 mu x 2 lam x 2 reward shapes x 2 (LSTM-feature ablation) = 24 configs. Each ~8 epochs x ~250 episodes; budget a full night at --jobs 2-4. Extend axes freely; qoe_quality selection stays comparable across reward specs.
